features.text: Advanced air pump system allows precise compression control to manage pain and swelling, letting you customize support levels as your healing progresses
SoftGait rocker bottom design helps maintain a natural walking pattern while keeping your injury properly immobilized for optimal healing
Tall profile provides enhanced stability from foot to lower leg, ensuring proper alignment and reducing strain during recovery
Breathable, moisture-wicking liner prevents skin irritation and maintains comfort during extended wear

measurement: For optimal healing support, proper fit is essential. Consult our sizing chart or connect with our medical team through our Perfect Fit Promise at for personalized fitting assistance.
